Privacy Policy

Last updated: 21 September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Priya's Aesthetics handles personal information collected through this website and direct enquiries.

Information we collect

We may collect the information you provide when you contact us, including your name, phone number, email address, business details and enquiry information. We may also receive limited technical information, such as browser type and page visits, to operate and improve this website.

How we use information

We use enquiry information to respond to requests, discuss products, provide customer support, maintain business records and meet applicable legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.

Sharing and storage

Information is shared only with service providers or authorities where necessary to operate the business, fulfil a request, comply with law or protect legal rights. We keep information only for as long as reasonably necessary for these purposes.

Your choices

You may request access to, correction of or deletion of personal information, subject to applicable law and record-keeping requirements. To make a request, use the contact details on our Contact Us page.

Updates

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will be posted on this page with its update date.
